topics.name: Schema Identity
topics.purpose: Define canonical schemas as stable semantic identities describing data shape independently from table/file/class names, storage engines and runtime instance values.

semantics.identity_rule: Every schema has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.storage_rule: Database table, file, class or serialization name is binding/implementation metadata.
semantics.instance_rule: Schema identity is distinct from any data instance identity.
semantics.field_rule: Fields are explicit child semantic identities.
semantics.composition_rule: Schemas may compose/reference other schemas through explicit relations/definitions.
semantics.authority_rule: Schema presence does not grant access to instance data.

invariants.rule: Schema, field and relation identities are explicit and stable; instance data, presentation labels and physical storage never define canonical schema semantics.

hard_gates.condition: schema identity inferred solely from table/file/class name
storage binding treated as semantic owner
